title: Rendering issue when scrolling in nvim
body: ### Issue description Before commit 52877c9a, scrolling inside nvim worked correctly. After this commit, scrolling causes screen corruption, where non‑nvim file content is incorrectly rendered on the screen (see screenshot below). ### Reproduction steps: 1. Start a new tmux session with a clean environment: ``` bash tmux -Ltest -f/dev/null new ``` 2. In that session, run nvim --clean cfg.c. 3. Scroll down to the bottom of the file, then scroll back up to the top. 4. Observe that the terminal displays content that does not belong to cfg.c, indicating the rendering corruption. ### Required information Please provide the following information. These are **required**. Note that bug reports without logs may be ignored or closed without comment. * tmux version (`tmux -V`). `tmux next 3.7 (current master)` * Platform (`uname -sp`). `Darwin i386` * Terminal in use (xterm, rxvt, etc). `iTerm` * $TERM *inside* tmux (`echo $TERM`). `screen-256color` * $TERM *outside* tmux (`echo $TERM`). `xterm-256color` * Logs from tmux (`tmux kill-server; tmux -vv new`).
